name: Kandagiri Spinning Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1976, Kandagiri Spinning Mills Ltd trades cotton yarn and leases out its immovable  properties[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KSML, part of the Sambandam Group, specializes in manufacturing:
a) 100% Cotton Yarn, BCI Yarn, and Organic Yarn in carded and combed varieties, available as single, double, TFO, weaving, and knitting yarn.
b) Value-added products like high twist, gassed, and mercerized compact yarn, and slub yarn.
c) Special yarns such as poly-cotton and bamboo yarn, with a count range of Ne 16's to 80's and Ne 2/16's to 2/80's.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 296 to 119 days.
Promoter holding has increased by 56.6% over last quarter.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -40.6% over past five years.
